name: goplex-plugins
description: Review and audit plugins for vibecoded applications.

plugins.name: vibecheck
plugins.description: Orchestrated review for vibecoded applications: a human-reviewed technical precheck, collection of static signals, guided code/live checks, a hardened Supabase probe, and an evidence-based workbook including GDPR and EU AI Act screening. Not a security certification or replacement for dedicated scanners.
